name: Ocean Dragon Lord - Neo-Daedalus
extDescription:
Corrected Text:
This card cannot be Normal Summon or Set. This card cannot be Special Summoned except by Tributing 1 Levia-Dragon - Daedalus on your side of the field. Send Umi on your side of the field to the Graveyard to send all cards in both players'' hands and on the field to the Graveyard, except this card.

Errata'd Text:
Send "Umi" on your side of the field to the Graveyard to send all cards in both players' hands and on the field to the Graveyard, except this card.

name: Mother Grizzly
extDescription: Effect: When this card is sent to the Graveyard as a result of battle you can Special Summon 1 WATER monster with an ATK of 1500 or less in face-up Attack Position from your Deck. The shuffle your Deck.

name: Star Boy
extDescription: Effect: As long as this card remains face-up on the field, increase the ATK of all WATER monster by 500 points and decrease the ATK of all FIRE monsters by 400 points.

name: Tribe-Infecting Virus
extDescription: Effect: Discard 1 card from your hand and declare 1 Type of monster. Destroy all face-up monsters of the declared Type on the field.

name: Fenrir
extDescription: Effect: This card cannot be Normal Summoned or Set. This card can only be Special Summoned by removing 2 WATER monsters in your Graveyard from play. When this card destroys an opponent''s monster as a result of battle, your opponent skips his/her next Draw Phase.

name: Amphibious Bugroth MK-3
extDescription: Effect: As long as Umi remains face-up on the field, this card can attack your opponent''s Life Points directly.

name: Levia-Dragon - Daedalus
extDescription: Send Umi on your side of the field to the Graveyard to destroy all cards on the field except this card.

name: Mermaid Knight
extDescription: Effect: As long as Umi remains face-up on the field, this card can attack twice during the same Battle Phase.

name: Mobius the Frost Monarch
extDescription: Effect: When this card is Tribute Summoned successfully, you can destroy up to 2 Spell or Trap cards on the field.

name: Unshaven Angler
extDescription: Effect: If you Tribute Summon a WATER monster, you can treat this 1 monster as 2 Tribute Monster for the Tribute Summon.

name: Creeping Doom Manta
extDescription: Effect: When this card is Normal Summoned successfully, no Trap Cards can be activated.

name: Snatch Steal
extDescription: Take control of one of your opponent''s face-up monsters. Your opponent gains 1000 Life Points at each of his/her Standby Phases.

name: Mystical Space Typhoon
extDescription: Destroy 1 Spell or Trap Card on the field.

name: Premature Burial
extDescription: Pay 800 Life Points. Select 1 monster from your Graveyard, Special Summon it on the field in face-up Attack Position, and equip it with this card. When this card is destroyed, destroy the equipped monster.

name: Pot of Greed
extDescription: Draw 2 cards from your Deck.

name: Heavy Storm
extDescription: Destroy all Spell and Trap Cards on the field.

name: A Legendary Ocean
extDescription: This card''s name is treated as Umi. Downgrade all WATER monsters in both player''s hands and on the field by 1 Level. Increases the ATK and DEF of all WATER monsters by 200 points.

name: Creature Swap
extDescription: Both players select 1 monster from their respective sides of the field and switch control of those monsters with each other. The selected monsters cannot change their battle positions this turn.

name: Reload
extDescription: Add your hand to your Deck and shuffle it. Then draw the same number of cards that you added to your deck.

name: Salvage
extDescription: Add 2 WATER monsters with an ATK of 1500 or less each in your Graveyard to your hand.

name: Hammer Shot
extDescription: Destroy 1 face-up Attack Position monster with the highest ATK on the field.

name: Big Wave Small Wave
extDescription: Destroy all face-up WATER monsters on your side of the field. Then you can Special Summon WATER monsters from your hand up to the same number of monsters destroyed by this effect.

name: Dust Tornado
extDescription: Destroy 1 spell or Trap Card on your opponent’s side of the field. You can then Set 1 Spell or Trap Card from your hand.

name: Call of the Haunted
extDescription: Select 1 monster from your Graveyard and Special Summon it in face-up Attack Position. When this card is removed from the field, destroy the monster. When the monster is destroyed, destroy this card.

name: Gravity Bind
extDescription: All Level 4 or higher monsters on the field cannot attack.

name: Tornado Wall
extDescription: This card can only be activated when Umi is active on the field. As long as Umi remains face-up on the field any damage from attacking monsters to your Life Points becomes 0. When Umi is removed from the field, this card is also destroyed.

name: Torrential Tribute
extDescription: You can only activate this card when a monster is Normal Summoned, Flip Summoned, or Special Summoned. Destroy all monsters on the field.

name: Spell Shield Type-8
extDescription:
Select and activate 1 of the following effects:
- Negate the activation and the effect of a Spell Card that targets 1 monster on the field and destroy the Spell Card.
- Send 1 Spell Card from your hand to the Graveyard to negate the activation and the effect of a Spell Card and destroy it.

name: Xing Zhen Hu
extDescription: Select 2 Set Spell or Trap Cards on the field and activate this card. As long as this card remains on the field the selected Spell or Trap Cards cannot be activated.
